rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice for a person, family, business, or place that is prosperous or doing very well.

example.english: This area has become much more prosperous in recent years.
example.traditional: 呢個地區近年發達咗好多。
example.jyutping: nei1 go3 dei6 keoi1 gan6 nin4 faat3 daat6 zo2 hou2 do1

rows.note: Use this specifically when prosperous means personally wealthy or well-off, rather than generally successful.

example.english: That whole family is very prosperous.
example.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 jat1 gaa1 jan4 hou2 jau5 cin2

rows.note: Use this slice when the focus is on a person, venture, or outcome being successful, without necessarily implying wealth.

example.english: This new venture is prosperous now.
example.traditional: 呢盤新生意做得好成功。
example.jyutping: nei1 pun4 san1 sang1 ji3 zou6 dak1 hou2 sing4 gung1

rows.note: Use this for a business, household, market, or locality that is thriving and flourishing.

example.english: This street used to be prosperous.
example.jyutping: nei1 tiu4 gaai1 ji5 cin4 hou2 hing1 wong6 gaa3
